# Ukraine BESS Arbitrage Index

> Public, source-backed BESS arbitrage analytics for Ukrainian OREE Day-Ahead Market prices.

Canonical public URL: https://energy-index.full-iron.com/ukraine-bess-arbitrage-index

This site is a post-defense public demo and portfolio surface for energy analytics.
It is not the private operator dashboard, not production dispatch software, and not a market bid or market-control system.

## Main Public Pages

- [Ukraine BESS Arbitrage Index](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/ukraine-bess-arbitrage-index): realized perfect-hindsight public BESS index from committed JSON artifacts.
- [Forecast Challenge](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/forecast-challenge): timestamped forecast artifacts and readiness labels.
- [Model Scoreboard](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/model-scoreboard): rolling forecast score area; ranked only after realized source data exists.

## Public Data Artifacts

- [Latest realized index JSON](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/data/bess-arbitrage-index/latest.json)
- [History JSON](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/data/bess-arbitrage-index/history.json)
- [Latest forecast JSON](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/data/bess-arbitrage-index/forecast/latest.json)
- [Forecast scoreboard JSON](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/data/bess-arbitrage-index/forecast_scoreboard.json)
- [Publication status JSON](https://energy-index.full-iron.com/data/bess-arbitrage-index/publication_status.json)

## Claim Boundary

- `market_execution_enabled=false`
- `proposed_bid_status=not_emitted`
- No market bids.
- No battery dispatch commands.
- No private tenant controls.
- No YASNO/DTEK integration claim.

## Source And Repository

- Source data: OREE Day-Ahead Market public price rows.
- Repository: https://github.com/ilyafefelov/Diploma
